item.title: Gateway fixes, router takeovers and another N-central hotfix
item.description: Good morning, it's 5:22 AM. Monday the seventh of September twenty twenty-six. 522 AM is brought to you by Lab522, at hello at lab522 dot co dot uk. Dell Secure Connect Gateway has two critical flaws with the same upgrade destination, including a remote command-execution route that doesn't need a login. That's a useful place to start your Monday.
